d: Dabang Delhi K.C. toppled Bengal Warriorz by 3 points in Match 39 of the Pro Kabaddi League Season 11, ending their losing streak. Ashu Malik went on to showcase his jaw-dropping raiding skills to score 10 raid points, while Nitin Kumar single-handedly led the Warriorz offence with 15 raid points. Tune into PKL Season 11 every day from 7:30 PM, only on the Star Sports Network and Disney+ hotstar. Catch all the LIVE updates on prokabaddi.com or the Pro Kabaddi Official App.
